description: Documentation + deploy runbook. EXTENDS the existing OG-SETUP.md with nginx mapping for bare /sitemap.xml and /robots.txt → the API (do NOT duplicate the file), and creates a new SEO-SETUP.md that sets realistic expectations (the module delivers full crawlability/indexability + correct meta + structured data + sitemap/robots as a technical foundation; actual ranking still depends on content/backlinks/time; no code guarantees #1), documents the admin SEO usage and the OG <=100KB reuse, and includes a final SUMMARY plus the exact EC2 deploy steps. Depends on FEAT-001 (endpoints/SQL) and FEAT-002 (admin UI) being in place so the docs describe the real surface; runs last.
steps: Extend 4astore-v2/api-node/OG-SETUP.md (append a new section, do NOT recreate the file) describing the nginx mapping so bare /sitemap.xml and /robots.txt proxy to the API, matching the existing crawler-rewrite style, e.g. `location = /sitemap.xml { proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/sitemap.xml; }` and the same for /robots.txt, with the reload line `sudo nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx`.

Create 4astore-v2/api-node/SEO-SETUP.md with: (1) What this delivers (admin-managed SEO + server-side meta/sitemap/robots + JSON-LD for crawlers; NO full SSR) and the realistic-expectation note that ranking depends on content/backlinks/time and no code guarantees #1; (2) the new endpoints (/api/sitemap.xml, /api/robots.txt, extended /api/og/* crawler meta) and the config.seo / per-product / per-page SEO fields; (3) admin usage of the SEO sub-tab (global defaults, per-product, per-page, previews, robots-extra); (4) the OG image reuse + <=100KB note.

Append to SEO-SETUP.md a SUMMARY section listing every added/edited file, and an exact EC2 deploy runbook: upload api-node src/** + prisma/seo.sql + prisma/schema.prisma and web dist/**; apply SQL `mysql -u <user> -p four_a_store < prisma/seo.sql`; run `npx prisma generate`; add the nginx location blocks + `sudo nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx`; `npm run build` (web, and api-node tsc build); `pm2 restart 4astore-api --update-env`. State explicitly: do NOT git commit/push.
acceptance_criteria: OG-SETUP.md contains a new (appended) section mapping bare /sitemap.xml and /robots.txt to the API, and the original OG content is preserved (not duplicated or removed).

SEO-SETUP.md exists, renders as valid Markdown, includes the realistic-expectation disclaimer, the endpoint + admin usage docs, the OG <=100KB reuse note, a SUMMARY of changed files, and the exact EC2 deploy steps (upload list, seo.sql apply, prisma generate, nginx additions, npm run build, pm2 restart --update-env), and states do-NOT-commit/push.
verification: Open OG-SETUP.md and confirm the appended sitemap/robots nginx section is present and the original OG sections are intact.
Open SEO-SETUP.md and confirm all required sections (realistic expectations, endpoints, admin usage, SUMMARY, EC2 deploy steps) are present and Markdown is well-formed.
findings: IMPLEMENTED & VERIFIED (docs). OG-SETUP.md EXTENDED (appended, original OG sections preserved intact) with a 'Sitemap & robots mapping (SEO module)' section: `location = /sitemap.xml { proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/sitemap.xml; }` + `location = /robots.txt { ... }`, note that these are NOT gated by the seoModule flag, plus `sudo nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx` and curl verify lines. SEO-SETUP.md CREATED with: (1) What this delivers + realistic-expectation note (no SSR, no ranking guarantee, ranking depends on content/backlinks/time); (2) new endpoints (/api/sitemap.xml, /api/robots.txt, extended /api/og/*) and SEO data fields (config.seo shape, per-product seo_*/og_image, pages.meta_keywords, POST /api/admin/seo contract) matching FEAT-001/FEAT-002 findings; (3) admin usage of the 🔎 SEO sub-tab (global defaults+LocalBusiness, per-product, per-page, previews, sitemap link, robotsExtra editor); (4) OG image reuse ≤100KB note; (5) SUMMARY listing every added/edited api-node + web file; (6) exact EC2 deploy runbook (upload src/**+prisma/seo.sql+schema.prisma + web dist/**, mysql apply seo.sql, npx prisma generate, nginx location blocks + nginx -t && reload, npm run build / tsc, pm2 restart 4astore-api --update-env) with an explicit do-NOT-git-commit/push statement for the deploy.
